## ICAN v0.1.3 — Configure APIs from the UI

Add providers using the existing custom-channel and parameter-translation system. The new form covers common HTTP generation APIs without changing the application or rebuilding its image.

- Start with blank, OpenAI-compatible or generic asynchronous-video settings. Presets initialize a new configuration; existing channels stay intact.
- Edit request fields, authentication, per-model parameter options, reference encoding, task/status/progress paths, results and authenticated downloads. Export/import versioned configuration without personal credentials.
- Preserve exact prompt, model, aspect ratio, resolution and duration strings through both the canvas and video workbench. No model-name guessing or replacement values for configured APIs.
- Reuse owned uploads and expiring reference links. Recheck ownership on the server, block cross-origin credential redirects and reject active content disguised as video.
- Keep existing accounts, media, channels, Keys and advanced translation rules. Private supplier configurations are not bundled.

### Prebuilt image

Platform: **Linux / amd64**. Source: `e03fc098cca2efdbac74a9e85f61b81692f9d4f9`.

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/ruoyeyu/ican@sha256:7c67aebfd53e60b2bbcdf5eed80b68742a756c9e5ca22bd5b3f6a601305d5580
```

Set `ICAN_IMAGE` in the existing protected environment file to the entire digest above. Keep the original `ICAN_DATA_DIR`, `DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `JWT_SECRET` and operator settings. The server only pulls and runs this image. Runtime limits remain **1.6 CPUs / 1.5 GiB**, with no additional swap.

The attached Compose, environment example and policy checker match the image source. Follow the [pull/start/update/rollback instructions](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/main/docs/security/ghcr-deployment.md): validate with `config --quiet`, create with `--no-build`, check the created container, then start.

### Checks and compatibility

Go tests, 30 Web tests, 294 Director tests, production builds, audits and final-image isolation/restart/runtime/Compose/security checks passed. [Build and publication](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/actions/runs/40179792350). Local production-browser tests covered import/edit/export, account recovery in a fresh browser and exact request capture. A real v0.1.2 binary created a disposable database/media/config backup; the new binary retained the account, encrypted Key, stable channel ID and media, and restoring that backup with the old binary passed. No paid API calls or production data were used.

The attached `publication.json` binds the source, immutable image, check run and evidence hashes. Raw scan matches: 0 critical, 0 high, 0 medium, 0 low; one UNKNOWN module match is retained. Its affected OpenPGP packages are absent from this exact source dependency list. No ignore filter or failed-check bypass was added.

This release adds no database tables or columns. Optional form/input metadata is versioned inside existing channel configuration. Stop writes and back up the full data directory, with original keys protected separately, before upgrading. Preserve a copy of data written after upgrading before any rollback. **To downgrade to v0.1.2, restore the pre-update configuration or matching full backup:** old clients cannot run the new form-generated raw-duration mappings. Never run two writers against one SQLite directory or use `down -v`.

Advanced JavaScript remains editable in the existing sandbox. Arbitrary hand-edited code cannot be automatically exported as a credential-free form; review/copy it in the advanced editor. Actual provider-specific reference modes and long-running tasks still need provider acceptance. This release does not close the [production resource, session and restore gates](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/main/docs/progress/todo.md), and no server was deployed or modified.

## 简体中文

**ICAN v0.1.3** 在原有自定义渠道与参数转译中增加界面配置。以后接入已支持 HTTP 协议的中转站，可编辑或导入配置，无需每次改代码、编译。公共预设只有空白、OpenAI 兼容、通用异步视频；不包含私人供应商或真实 Key。

- 逐模型配置字段、鉴权、时长/分辨率/比例、素材编码、任务 ID、轮询状态、进度、结果和同源鉴权下载。
- 画布和视频工作台保留原始 prompt、模型、比例、分辨率和时长；未知中间状态继续查询，不自动重建收费任务。
- 明确要求 URL 的图片、首尾帧、视频、音频复用私有素材上传和限时授权。服务端复核归属，拦截跨域凭据重定向及伪装成视频的 HTML/JSON。
- 配置导出不带个人凭据；导入校验必要字段，创建新渠道，不覆盖已有配置。旧高级代码仍可编辑，但不自动导出为表单。

**服务器不用编译。** 使用上方固定 digest 和附件中的 Compose，运行上限仍为 1.6 核、1.5 GiB。保留原数据库、媒体目录、账号/API 配置、DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY 和 JWT_SECRET。本地浏览器、免费 mock、旧版本数据副本升级/回滚及最终镜像检查记录随附件提供。

更新前停写并做一致性备份。回退 v0.1.2 须同时恢复更新前的配置或完整备份，旧客户端不能执行新规则；恢复前另存升级后的数据。真实供应商模式和生产运行仍需验收。本次未连接或修改部署服务器。
